北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京体感 6℃，风力 3 级，风大干燥，注意保暖补水哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing feels 6℃ with 3-level wind, breezy and dry. Stay warm and hydrated!
北京.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降5℃

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪气温 20℃，多云舒适，享受这宜人的天气吧！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is 20℃ and cloudy, quite pleasant. Enjoy the lovely weather!
慈溪.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阳光明媚，气温 21℃，体感舒适，美好的一天！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is sunny and 21℃, feeling great. Have a wonderful day!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州 28℃ 晴朗，暖意融融。记得多喝水哦！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is sunny and 28℃, quite warm. Remember to stay hydrated!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳 26℃ 晴朗有风，出门感受阳光与微风吧！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is sunny with 26℃ and 3-level wind. Enjoy the sunshine and breeze!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州 20℃ 多云，体感 19℃，空气润泽，适合户外活动。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy at 20℃, feeling 19℃. Moist air, good for outdoors!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京 21℃ 晴朗干燥，注意补水，享受阳光吧！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is sunny and 21℃, feeling a bit dry. Hydrate and enjoy the sun!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，气温 19℃。出门记得带把伞哦。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy with 19℃. Don't forget an umbrella when you go out.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉 21℃ 晴朗，体感舒适。享受阳光好心情！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is sunny and 21℃, feeling pleasant. Enjoy the sunshine and good mood!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安 18℃ 晴朗，湿度仅 5%，非常干燥！多喝水哦。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is sunny 18℃, only 5% humidity, very dry! Drink plenty of water.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆 21℃ 多云，体感舒适，户外活动很不错哦。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy and 21℃, feeling comfortable. Great for outdoor activities!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨-1℃ 霾，体感-8℃，风大天冷。务必穿暖和！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is -1℃ with haze, feels -8℃, windy and cold. Dress warmly!
哈尔滨.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳体感 1℃，北风微凉。出门注意保暖防寒哦。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang feels 1℃ with a chilly north wind. Remember to keep warm!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明 21℃ 晴朗，体感 15℃ 且干燥。记得带外套，多饮水。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is sunny 21℃, feels 15℃ and dry. Bring a jacket, drink water.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门 24℃ 晴朗，体感温暖舒适，适合海边漫步。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is sunny and 24℃, feeling warm and comfy. Perfect for a walk by the sea!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛大雾，体感 4℃。出行注意交通安全，注意保暖。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is foggy, feels 4℃. Drive safe and keep warm!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连 5℃ 有雾，体感 2℃。注意交通安全，别忘了添衣。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is 5℃ and foggy, feels 2℃. Stay safe on the road and dress warmly!
大连.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃
